body: @rsvoboda Not sure it should be marked as a bug, since there was no code presented there. My understanding the code was not added there because the demo is not really about the code but the login, though may be that code can be copied.... But I'd consider it be an enhancement request :-) CC @pedroigor

@sberyozkin I think I agree. The guide is only about protecting a web app serving pages that can only be accessed after the user is authenticated. 

@rsvoboda Do you mean we should update guide to describe in more detail the `TokenResource` ?

I meant differences like

https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/master/docs/src/main/asciidoc/security-openid-connect-web-authentication.adoc#configuring-using-the-applicationproperties-file
```
quarkus.oidc.auth-server-url=http://localhost:8180/auth/realms/quarkus
quarkus.oidc.client-id=frontend
quarkus.oidc.client-type=web-app
```

https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus-quickstarts/blob/adb7a530264249d02ede94474a6822bf605e1afd/security-openid-connect-web-authentication-quickstart/src/main/resources/application.properties#L1-L6
```
quarkus.oidc.auth-server-url=http://localhost:8180/auth/realms/quarkus
quarkus.oidc.client-id=frontend
quarkus.oidc.application-type=web-app
quarkus.http.auth.permission.authenticated.paths=/*
quarkus.http.auth.permission.authenticated.policy=authenticated
quarkus.log.category."com.gargoylesoftware.htmlunit.DefaultCssErrorHandler".level=ERROR
```
Thanks @rsvoboda for pointing to it. We can probably avoid adding the `htmlunit` log category to the docs, it is really related to minimizing the noise during the test.

a bit confused about `quarkus.oidc.client-type=web-app` vs `quarkus.oidc.application-type=web-app` difference

Seems `quarkus.http.auth.permission.authenticated.paths=/*` and `quarkus.http.auth.permission.authenticated.policy=authenticated` were necessary to pass tests.  See https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus-quickstarts/issues/366
@rsvoboda a user has just reported this issue on Zulip :-), I mean, the `client-type` is an old name and is not supported

@rsvoboda Hmm, not sure now why those permission properties had to be added, @stuartwdouglas, can you please clarify ? I'm not seeing which changes at https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/5315 might've caused it. If all the users need to do is to login with OIDC code flow, should they be required to configure the permissions ?
Started with #5414. I'd still like to discuss with Stuart if we need to ask the users to configure the permissions in the application.properties in addition to enabling the OIDC adapter.

You need to say which parts of the app need permissions. If you are only going to public pages it will not ask you to log in, only if you attempt to access a protected resource. 

If you are using REST endpoints this can just be via annotations, or you can use the application.properties approach.
